pairs.question: Dic, quid uidetur esse uerum et congruens, unumne Christum colere et in Christo patrem, an conprecari mille formarum deos?
pairs.answer: Est quidquid illud, quod ferunt homines deum, unum esse oportet, et, quod uni, est unicum. cum Christus hoc sit, Christus est uerus deus, genera deorum multa nec pueri putant.
pairs.derivation: Romanus asks the child a real interrogative (unum...colere...an conprecari...?). Dropped the framing/narration 'Romanus ardens experiri innoxiam / lactantis oris indolem: "filiole", ait,' and the address 'filiole' before the question proper; normalized 'dic' capitalization. Answer drops the speech tag 'Adrisit infans nec moratus rettulit:' and runs to the end of the child's verbatim reply.

pairs.question: Quis auctor uocis est huius tibi?
pairs.answer: Mater et matri deus: illa ex parente spiritu docta inbibit, quo me inter ipsa pasceret cunabula, ego ut gemellis uberum de fontibus lac paruus hausi, Christum et hausi credere.
pairs.derivation: Asclepiades asks the child a direct interrogative; dropped the embedded speech tag 'inquit' from "'quis auctor', inquit, 'uocis est huius tibi?'". Answer drops the speech tag 'Respondit ille:' and quotes the child's full verbatim reply to its terminal full stop.
